title: Handle change line
summary: A quiet line in the timeline when a person in the chat set, changed or removed their @, at the time of the change (ADR 0066). The line is local: bipe-api holds the history, no Matrix event exists.

name.description: The person's current display name in this room.

oldHandle.description: The @ before. Missing on a first set.

newHandle.description: The @ after. Missing on a removal.

at.description: Time of the change from bipe-api.

notes: Move, do not rewrite: BipeKit BipeHandleChanges.swift (BipeHandleChange.line(name:), BipeHandleChangePlacement.placements, BipeHandleChangeStore) and libraries/bipe BipeHandleChanges.kt.
Source: bipe-api POST /v1/handle-changes with the Matrix IDs of the members of the joined rooms, at most 100 per call, since the newest cached change. The cache lives on the device per account.

Placement: inside the loaded range only, before the first row newer than the change. A change newer than the last row shows at the end only when the timeline is live. No line for a person who is not a member now, or for a change before the person joined. Back-pagination brings older lines in.
Text: old and new: bipe_handle_changed (name, new, old). New only: bipe_handle_set (name, new). Old only: bipe_handle_removed (name, old). Neither: no line.
The row id is bipe-handle-change-<userId>-<at in ms>, so it stays stable across rebuilds.
Same in a DM and a group (ADR 0141 keeps it). A failed fetch keeps the cache and tries again on the next open.
